body.title: Time a real daemon DEF review and confirm the route end to end
body.summary: Run last, on the finished build. Run the daemon review request on a real controller-authored DEF in this repo and record how long it took against the 10 minute wait limit. Run the two review tools once each on real controller-authored work, then approve one really-reviewed artifact without an override. No code change unless the limit is shown to be wrong.
acceptanceChecks: The build record states the time a daemon DEF review took and whether the 10 minute default fits
The build record states the verdict each review tool returned on real controller-authored work and that the review was stamped by the daemon
One artifact reviewed this way is approved with no override reason

tests.name: a real daemon review of a controller-authored DEF, timed against the 10 minute limit
both review tools on real controller-authored work return the daemon's verdict, and one such artifact is approved with no override
